product_title: Alesis Melody 32 – Electric Keyboard Digital Piano with 32 Keys, Speakers, 300 Sounds, 300 Rhythms, 40 Songs, USB-MIDI Connectivity and Piano Lessons
description: " The Ultimate Go-Anywhere Portable Electric Keyboard – Introducing the Melody 32 from Alesis Simplify learning the digital piano with the Melody 32 from Alesis. This ultra-portable piano packs an arsenal of premium features into a back-pack friendly keyboard, that’s ready to make music wherever you go, including: 300 high-quality digital keyboard sounds (including traditional piano, orchestral instruments, guitars, drums and sound effects); 32 keys with a natural response that captures every inflection of your delivery; built-in speakers that deliver room filling sound perfect for performing to your friends and family; 40 demo tracks to play along to; and even a record mode for capturing your performance on the fly. Add to this a dedicated headphone output for private practice and even an Accompaniment Mode packed with 300 rhythms and this pint-sized electronic piano gives you everything you need for performing, practicing or simply having some fun learning the keyboard! Play Piano Anywhere, Anytime The Melody 32 can be powered via USB or with 4 AA batteries (not included), making this electric keyboard the perfect solution to practice outside or take it to a friend’s house. Piano Lessons Included Melody 32 comes packed with piano lessons including 3-Months of Skoove Premium and 2-Months of TakeLessons | Live. Skoove is the easiest way to learn piano—featuring in-depth online piano courses that adapt to you and give you feedback as you go. With TakeLessons, you’ll learn faster than ever with live classes with real, expert teachers! Raise your hand, ask questions, interact with other class members, and have fun! Take as many classes as you want - there are hundreds of classes each month to pick from. ".
features: Feature Packed Digital Piano for Kids – Portable electronic keyboard with 32 premium mini piano style keys with power via USB or 4 AA batteries (not included)
Premium Electric Piano Keyboard Sounds - 300 voices (including Acoustic Piano, Electric Piano, Strings, Organ, Synth, Drums and much more); built in speakers that deliver room-filling sound
Practice Makes Perfect – 1/8” stereo headphone output mutes the built in speakers; 40 Demo songs; accompaniment mode with 300 built-in rhythms; built in record feature for recording your performance
Play Keyboard Anywhere - Power via the included USB cable or 4 AA batteries (not included) for professional piano performance wherever you go
Powerful Educational Features - Skoove 3 month premium subscription for interactive online piano lessons; Two months of live video lessons from TakeLessons

positive_reviews: I decided to go with this keyboard because its decent sized and the bench is better quality than I expected. I like the separate volumes and having 300 voices and 300 beats to explore is great. The headphones work; not the best but at least it comes with a tool that allows "quiet practice." The microphone is pretty small but the fact it has an input that can allow rough vocals to come through the mix works for me. I have not looked into downloading more voices / beats which is another good feature.

My son loves this keyboard! It is easily mobile, the sound is adjustable, and there are setting to change the sound outputs. If you buy this for a super beginner, BUY A MUSIC BOOK. The directions are for set up only. There is no key identification in the booklet. The sound quality is better than a battery operated keyboard but is not pristine. It is perfect for someone figuring out their talents. I bout this for Christmas and now in April it still works well. My son carries it around the house and the sole function of a headphone outlet is a God send.

i bought this for the 300 drum beats,the fact you can record your own and play it back to jam to is awsome.im running it through a 1800 watt mixer with a guitar effects pedal and a 6 band eq on the effects loop.sounds great.the drum effects are as good as any drum machine.and a bonus has lots of different tones to play around with.im 190 lbs and 6 ft the stool holds me.its a little short but it holds secure.the mic is shurely for little kids , its very low grade,the headphones are decent.if you can run it through a amp you will get better sound than just the speakers.still a good buy .
It's a food piano for bigginers, just a little noise comes from speaker when nothing's playing on it but not that bad

Bought this for my 14 yr old son, he plays it all the time. Has many many features and he loves it! Got the beginners playbook as well. Only slightly concerning is the stool seems a bit small and not so sturdy but overall GREAT FOR STARTERS!

This was a really good buy for my money.  while in quarantine I decided I could teach myself to play.  this unit came with the stool, the stand a mic (kinda of cheap plastic so I haven't used it) headphones (these are awesome because when I want to practice the whole house does not have to hear me!  And they work great!)  I give four stars on sound quality because the settings do not stay where you leave them once you turn the keyboard off so when I return the default goes back to the highest settings.  other than that I have really enjoyed this purchase and think it was a great deal for a beginner for the money.
I love everything about it! Love that you can record and play back what you played so as a beginner you really hear what you sound like playing!!

I've never touched a keyboard or instrument. But this was easy to assembly and provides what I needed for a beginner.
Lots of options but I only needed the piano function.
Headphones and microphone we're on the cheap end and I don't really use.
If you are worried about being loud while practicing, any earphone with the standard jack will connect.
Note: invest in some tape, a sharpie, and a whiteboard for practice as well
Last photo is how to label your keyboard to practice (:

For the price, this is great. My only complaint is that, even at its very lowest setting, it is very loud. I got it for my 9 year old for Christmas and that's his complaint, as well. It's also too loud in the headphones for him to be comfortable using them. It's still great quality but not something you could practice very quietly on.
The volume is a little loud. Even on the lowest setting it can be heard clear across the house. But so far it seems sturdy and the sound is okay.
negative_reviews: It has no velocity on the keys! That is, it doesn't matter how hard you press the key, it plays at the same volume no matter what. Also, the lowest volume setting is super LOUD! Everything else is alright I guess.
Stand broke. And microphone has static in it. Keyboard don't sound good eirher

No sound. Bought as a Christmas gift when the recipient unboxed it and hooked everything up it had no sound through speakers or with the headphones connected I was just told today so it is to late to return.

Completely worthless!! The speaker started crackling after 2 months of very minimal use. The volume was not up loud either. and it's after the point where we can return it to Amazon. Save your money, and you're child's heartache.
The piano is low quality and the charger causes a static sound.

It works fine in producing sounds, but the sound quality is pretty poor. Also, when using headphones, there's always noise coming from it.
It worth the money because it's so cheap, but if you plan to learn the piano for a long time, it's not a good choice.
I didn't get a microphone and the keyboard turns off while it's being played.

The product has a lot of features for the attractive price. So good first impression. However when using the headphones there is a lot of disturbing static and noises, which are distracting and annoying. Also the stand is not well designed and fitting the keyboard.
I bought this hoping to have a great starter; but the speakers sound like they are under water. Also it didn’t come with a sustain option on the piano. Beware.

positive_reviews: Works great, I bought this for my son to use for music class (he is homeschooled). I was a bit nervous because a lot of people were saying theirs sounded robotic but I’ve had no issues with the sound on mine. It sounds fine.
This is the best thing I have ever wanted. God knows how I desired for this and finally got it at my age of 23. Everything should turn out to be great then.

Many other buttons that I do not think I will ever get to use, Tried to register it, but that was impossible. I like my keyboard piano so I bought one for my 4-year-old grandson, since he would not leave mine alone.
I can’t even believe how incredible this keyboard is!!! It has a ton of features for an crazy low price!!!
Bought this for my 7yo son after the previous two purchases (different brand) had keys that didn’t work. This purchase cost a little more, but it has worked perfectly.
My 5 year old grand daughter really wants to learn to play the piano.  So I decided to get her a portable key board for starters.  She loves it. Can't leave it alone.  Sounds great and looks great.

It is great piano for beginners. But online class came with this product is garbage. I mean I'm not talking about trial thing. It isn't worth it. AT ALL!
My kind taking personal class from the guitar center.

Being a musician myself I wanted to encourage music for my grandchildren so this keyboard was purchased. They live out of state and I haven't had the opportunity to play it yet myself to check the sound quality or key action, but my grandson and daughter like it very much.
This product is good for beginners. The sound quality isn't the best, but my grand babies are loving it
I think this is great for a first keyboard and great prices
negative_reviews: Don't like the sound of it.. doesn't come with pedal.. moreover, the music rest doesn't fit into the grooves.. electronic buttons feel cheap.. makes me believe there must be better products out there..

I am not impressed. I am stunned by all the great reviews, both from professional and amateur reviewers. The piano setting does NOT sound even remotely like a piano. The keys have a horrible, mushy feel. There is a reason that this keyboard is so cheap. Spend more or plan to be frustrated.

I never normally write reviews for products on amazon but I had to for this product. Please listen to me when I say avoid buying this product even for a beginner in piano. It sounds, feels, and looks like a toy. The microphone and headphone are terrible and it just sounds really, really bad. This sounds so much like a toy. Instead go up another 100 bucks and get a Yamaha NP12 from Guitar Center if it’s here you. I’m returning this thing.
There has never been a time I went to sit at this keyboard, and the provided bench did not make a fart noise as I sat. Hard to get past that. Spend an extra 50 on something better
While the piano is on it always has like a beep sound. I suggest to get a better piano for 20 dollars more.

Very disappointed in this keyboard. It looks nice but as soon as you begin playing it reminds you of that child's toy piano you had from the five and dime store years ago. The tones were cheap and the action was clunky. It's a shame the only good thing was the speaker volume.

It should tell you something when they have a video of the keyboard with a real piano playing in the background for sound as opposed to the actual sound of this keyboard. I have owned several keyboards in my life. Nothing super crazy but usually around the 80 to 100 dollar range. This is hands down the worst sounding thing I have ever heard in my life. Videos of the sound don't actually capture how terrible the sound really is because the recording device sucks. It sounds like a 5 dollar cheap robotic toy just before the batteries die on it. Absolute junk. I wouldnt pay more than 10 dollars for this let alone 100.
This whole system sounds like a 19.99 Walmart keyboard.

I would give this 0 stars if I could. I purchased for my daughter for Christmas and regret it immensely. It was her only gift she asked for. I thought for the price it should be decent, however the sound is distorted, there is frequency being omitted from the speakers even when you aren’t touching the keys. The piano tone doesn’t actually sound like a piano. It sound like a bad baby toy. I’ve played keyboards in the children’s section at Walmart that has better sound quality and even cheaper prices. I do not recommend for anyone to purchase.

positive_reviews: Had it for many months for my son. He is using it Works well.
Cant be beat for the price! Love it
I bought this for my son. It's his first instrument. I was pleasantly surprised at how quickly it got here and how nice it is. I love it.

My 8 and 11 year old have been playing with this every day for over a month now. When I tell them it's time to be done with video games they don't fight me quite as hard. It's very high quality. Very pleased!

Went through a LOT of reviews to find one that would be a good starter for my 6-year-old. Didn't want it to cost a fortune, she is only 6. Arrived quickly, packaging was great, everything was as it should be and received all accessories that were to come with it. Tested every key and the headphones and everything worked like a charm. negative_reviews: Was great until it stopped working less than 6 months after we received it. Didn’t use batteries, just the plug...

keyboard is nice and sounds good for the kids but the microphone came broke. Didnt even get to use once.

Now 2 months later, after sporadic use, there are 4 keys that don't work at all and the digital display is going out.  Only buy if you're looking for a "toy".  Definitely won't be able to be used for lessons, now.
Some of the Keys stop working after 2 months overall it was a good gift in the beginning just wished it lasted longer

We loved the piano and then today I let my daughter use the headphone and microphone, which we had not done in a while and now it is producing no sound at all. I am not sure what happened to cause this.
Both the microphone and headphones broke within a handful of uses. Pretty cheap quality but that's what we paid for.
It was great when it worked for my son. It stopped working after 5 months and you can smell a component burning (chip u2).

This keyboard is very, very nice.  It is by far better than I expected and my grand daughter love it.  Really a standard siclze.  Her father plays it also.  It came on time and that is why I  love Amazon.  I get all my things on or before the expected time.

negative_reviews: Im a total beginner so this is fine for me, but honestly for what I spent I should have just spent the extra thirty dollars on a good Yamaha keyboard. This one has no realistic piano sound and the stand only works because it's leaning against my wall. The keys and all of it are pretty cheaply made and I'm pretty sure this will probably break before i grow out of it and get a new one. Again, it's okay since I'm a total beginner but really for the price you can get so much better.
If you don't know how to sell a tuned piano don't sell it. My clean advice.  If somebody could fix the problem, notify me if possible.

Bought this for my grandsons birthday. I didn’t get to actually play and hear it for some weeks later. When I did I found poor sound quality and stiff key movement. I would say, it’s just ok, but for me it is more like a toy. The grandson is 9 and is using it, and he likes it. Using it to learn notes and chords, but he doesn’t have anything to compare it to. Spend a few more dollars for a keyboard that has good sound, and keys that have smooth movement. Maybe go to a music store and play a few different brands, get the make and model and shop online for best price.

The keyboard itself is alright. It sounds like it's slightly out of tune, but it works. The stand provided, however, is A JOKE. It was not designed well, so you HAVE to lean the entire thing against a wall or it will fall over backwards. To be perfectly honest, I would say find a different brand and don't spend your money on this one. It's worth maybe half it's price.

the sound is super fake and honestly sounds nothing like an actual piano. when you play it, the keys sound like plastic. all of the different sounds just sound more cheesy as you try them. the sustain only works for about 5 seconds before all the sound goes away. overall, sure its cheap... but it's still a waste of money. I say buy a keyboard that yes, might be a bit more pricey, but is way worth it in the long run, sounds good, and won't just sit in your room for a year until you finally decide to write a review on how bad it is (what I am currently doing as we speak)

I should have known that it was too good to be true to buy a decent keyboard without paying $300+. It's week 3 and the left speaker does this fuzzy sound thing EVEN when no key is getting pressed. I been practicing everyday for about 30 minutes and I would not have suspected that the quality would go so low so fast. It's almost discouraging. I had really hope that I would get some bang for my buck here after researching for day but I should have known better I suppose. Would not recommend. It's heartbreaking. Get you a good keyboard with midi capabilities.

I bought this keyboard "SuperKit" for my 6 year old granddaughter. I liked being able to get the stand, stool, and headphones along with the keyboard. The reviews were so good that I thought that I'd be safe to try this unfamiliar brand.
Unfortunately, I had return the items because two keys in the middle of the keyboard had a very high pitch screeching sound. I returned it to get another one with even more keys that were screeching. Because my granddaughter may take piano lessons, I feel it is important that she has better quality.
So, I returned two of these, but I will say that Amazon was terrific to give me credit for the returned items. It was hard to take my granddaughter's Christmas present away from her twice.
I ordered a Yamaha, at a greater expense, and it is wonderful. I should have known better to begin with. You usually get what you pay for.
Sound is so so. But the biggest problem was when the welding on the stool broke right off and my daughter fell if the chair while playing, and she weighs 90 pounds.
Cheaply made and overpriced. you get what you  pay for. Spend 40 more dollars get quality.
Don’t buy it. This thing does not even sound like and actual piano. Please trust me on this if you are reading.

Our kids and family love this.  I like it because it comes with headphones!  Only problem is whoever is playing with headphones on can't hear mom calling. Keys are easy to play, don't stick and hav ethe feel of a piano.
Received product much sooner than expected; quality was great and nothing broken. Was exactly what I expected with no problems. Was a gift and arrived on time.

I purchased this for my daughter about to take piano lessons and we had no room for a piano.  It offers tutorial on it to learn songs as well.  Since this purchase (1 week) my two sons now are asking to take lessons since they are enjoying the tutorial as well.  I LOVE the fact that the headphones plug in and you don't hear them practicing, then they can unplug when they want to have you hear them when they are feeling accomplished at the end of a lesson.  The headphones did come defective; right side had a rattle noise, like a broken part, and does not work.  Customer Service was excellent when I contacted them however.  Great experience w/Amazon all around!

I frequently read MANY product AND seller reviews before purchasing an item on Amazon and so I did before purchasing this keyboard after my daughter lost mine away at college. By reading the old and new reviews one can decide whether a seller has fixed any complaints that will dissuade future customers from dealing with them.
So many keyboards don't have AC adapters or they have the wrong adapters. The stands are wrong. The headphones are wrong...
Read ALL reviews before buying!
The most recent reviews of this keyboard were outstanding and Amazon as the seller apparently has made sure all pieces are in the box and that everything fits and everything works.(And right now it's around $100 with free shipping!)
Mine arrived today, went together in very few minutes. Everything is there,everything fits,everything works..AND I'M 100% SATISFIED.
Thanks Amazon.
negative_reviews: This keyboard does not feature touch response, as the listing said at the time of purchase. I have contacted customer support, and hope that will be changed soon. It is light and portable, though has the less full sound you'd expect from a low-cost instrument.

Don't do it!!! I purchased this keyboard for my 6 and 7 year old boys for Christmas and are you ready?????
1 - There was no power supply in the box
2 - The headphones are the wrong ones and cannot be used with the keyboard
3 - The stand does not fit properly

BUT, here is the best part...I HAVE to return everything in order to get a refund!! They will not replace the incorrect items, refund for the incorrect items OR allow me to return just the incorrect items. So, I have to wrap everything back up, ship it back to Amazon and purchase a new keyboard. Not much of a Christmas present. I feel terrible for my boys because the keyboard itself was their favorite Christmas present (they did not realize all that was wrong/missing), but I have to pack it back up and return it because the company did not deliver what they promised.

Am disappointed, the head phone is not working. It's kind of frustrating to me cause my kids are not making use of the headphone. Whenever they play it disturb everyone in the living room as we live in an apartment building. I will be happy if a working headphone is provided to give me the maximum satisfaction and comfort we desire.

Again i will like to pay for warranty for the product, please send me the warranty price.

Ogechukwu

I should have listened to the reviews I read but I did not. It was a good price for the set but ANOTHER incorrect adapter issue. I am so disappointed that the seller, after all of the bad reviews, has not corrected the issue. Yes, another adapter can be purchased but why should it have to be?!! It is just REALLY REALLY bad customer service. On a positive note, the keyboard (once batteries were used) worked fine.

Keyboard is good.

Quality of the accessories are cheap at best.

Hardly 10 days, one side of the headphones stopped working...

Better buy the keyboard and accessories separate.

Ordered this keyboard set for my daughter, but upon arrival there was no power supply included.  Called customer service who told me I would have to return the entire package and they would send a replacement order.  It came promptly, only to NOT have a power supply!!!  The features also at the time of my order indicated that the package included a music stand, song book, and microphone.  None of which either package really had!!  I ended up having to return both packages because amazon.com could not send out a power supply.  I order from Amazon.com often and this is really the first problem I have had, but I am disappointed nonetheless.  I gave it two stars because at least the customer service did send a replacement (although non-complete) promptly.  I have since ordered a package for another company!!

The keyboard itself is nice. The way the entire package is put together is pretty sad though. The stand is ok and fits the keyboard generically. The bad part was that the headphone jack is the wrong size for the keyboard. It seems like a huge hassle to return the entire bundle to get the correct headphones. Good luck trying to get help with incorrect merchandise on Amazon!

positive_reviews: I bought this for my 4 year old daughter. Everything works perfectly so far in-spite of it having seen some rigorous play using elbows and wrists and other items. Have kept the keyboard on for days without being unplugged or switched off. No issues there as well. Have not used the battery option yet. The resistance of the keys is not as much as that of the piano, but I suppose that is to be expected. For the price, it is a good buy. Same items if bought individually cost more than this bundle price.

First, I must say that I am only a beginner. I think the keyboard sounds great and I look forward to learning how to use it. Second, I think the package is a great deal, including the keyboard, stand, power supply and headphones. I read the other reviews about problems with the stand, power suppy and headphones -- I had none of those problems. The stand is sturdy and the keyboard sits well on top, even though it does not fasten. (Look for the connecting screws that fasten the "legs" to the "arms" inside the stand, they are not packaged separately.) The generic power supply works fine. The headphones come with an adapter for the connector to plug it into the keyboard. Everything works great, was packaged well and arrived in excellent condition. It didn't make sense to spend an extra $20 - $40 to buy everything separately.
This is a great Christmas gift. It is easy to set up and appears to be a quailty product.I also like that it comes with headphones,stand and power supply.
The headphone adaptor came with mine.  The stand is a decent generic one- same as the power supply.  It sounds good and works fine.  Good deal for the price.
To be totally honest, this keyboard is pretty sweet! Everything's to my satisfaction, except that the power supply is a BIT short. Just a bit.

I was a little hesitant to buy this package because many of you have experienced issues with your power supply and keyboard stand.  I took a chance because of the low price, and I have not been disappointed.  My package came with a World Tour WTAD 5 power supply, which works flawlessly.  The keyboard stand only needed four screws to put it together and it didn't give me any trouble at all.  Based on previous reviews, I didn't expect the stand to be able to screw into the keyboard, so that didn't disappoint me.  I plugged the headphones into my mp3 player and they worked just fine.  As for the keyboard itself, I am satisfied.  I am using it to make background music for films that I make, and it performs admirably.  It would be nice if it saved music files even after being turned off, but I can't complain about getting so much for $120.  I found this package to be an excellent buy.

Prior to ordering this item, i read most of the reviews. The common problem seems to be the adapter that comes with this package. It isnt the original Casio adapter, and this seems to cause equipment failure if used.
This is what I did and recommended for you to do as well:
Rather than getting this package where the keyboard, adapter (generic), and keyboard stand come together, go to the listing on Amazon that just sells the keyboard alone. Then on that same page, it gives you the option to add the adapter and keyboard stand to the purchase. I believe the total then comes out to $129 altogether. This is $10 more than the listing where the give you the package deal with the generic adapter. I personally feel its worth spending an extra $10 to get the original casio adapter rather than using the generic which the casio instruction manual says not to use (or else risk equipment failure).
I just purchased it in the way I mentioned above, got in the mail last week, and everything works perfectly.
Spend the extra $10 and save yourself the headache of replacing a malfunctioned keyboard.
Hope this helps!

Received this keyboard and my kids opened it on Christmas, awesome sound quality but the headphones included in the package did not fit.  The headphone jack is not a standard one and it needs an adapter to make it work.  The manual clearly states this keyboard doesn't come with headphones so the seller added it as a bonus...to bad they didn't work, otherwise I would've rated this 5 stars.

I was concerned about this package due to some negative reviews I've read here, but everything turned out to be great.
The adapter is not a brand name, but it does have the right configuration - 9v, 850mA just like the Casio adapter. The stand comes with all the screws already in place and it only took 5 minutes or less to set it up. Headphones are on the cheap side but they are OK too, and the keyboard itself is great!
If somehow the adapter that came in the package is not right, I believe Amazon will ship the Casio one for free, but it wasn't needed in my case.

Great price everything came with it I was skeptical at first about buying this paticular Keyboard because of The head phones some stated theres did not work properly So I decides Ill take a chance  but I must tell You when I purchased it I received it on time :) I was so excited , & its a great learning instrument &  the headphones work fine & the stand was easy to assemble!! :)
negative_reviews: It looks good but had no power cable with it so we have not been able to use it. The supplier promised to forward a power supply but one has never come. Also, the headphones included are not the correct ones for the keyboard and the jack does not fit. Extremely disappointing supplier. I would not recommend buying anything from them.

The keyboard is okay but the adaptor is nor Casio's speciallized adaptor for electric keyboard and the importance is that IT IS BROKEN!! I am using it with 6 AA batteries. An another bad thing is that the headphone not only looks really cheap but is not even compatible with the keyboard. The output hole at the back of the keyboard is way much bigger so you definetely need a converter! Anyway, I am going to contact amazon to return the adaptor.

Why the hell are you guys selling this as a package when the headphones don't fit the keyboard and the A/C adapter doesn't work at all.  Good keyboard but just throw the headphones and adapters away!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I bought this keyboard as a package.  Well, it turns out that stand has one missing screw.  So stand becomes useless..of course I can go out and try to find right size screw and put it in but I wasn't expecting to do that.  My neighbour had exactly the same problem.  Had I known this before, I wouldn't have bought the package deal.  Just buy the Casio keyboard.

I bought the Casio CTK-2100 61-key portabel keyboard package with headphones, stand and power supply for my granddaughter for Christmas -- what a dishonest caper Amazon and Casio have perpetrated! Apparently the fact that the adapter and headphone included in the package has been clearly documented for over a year but yet it keeps shipping. Bad enough that they keep shipping it but they have not made arrangement to have the incompatible parts replaced -- if you try to send back just the depective parts, 1) Amazon will charge you for the whole package unless you send back the whole package 2) there is no way to talk on the phone to anyone about it without incurring a "premium service" charge. My granddaughter has already started taking music lessons with the keyboard. So as not to interrupt her lessons, i just paid $14.00 for the correct adapter. I am now headed to the Consumer Affairs website to file a complaint!!!!

From the moment we opened it we have been disappointed. With batteries, it works and is great, but batteries do not last long. With the power cord, it will work for a second and then it is done. We got a new cord and the same thing happened. Very disappointed and will not use this seller again. Should have listened to other reviews.

DO NOT ORDER THE PACKAGE! GET THE CASIO KEYBOARD ALONE AND PURCHASE ACCESSORIES SEPARATELY! Like many others on these reviews, the generic adapter broke after a day and the headphones were incompatible with the keyboard!!! Wish I had not fallen for the deal and spent $10 extra and bought them separately. Keyboard very nice though.
Bought it in September and it broke in December.  I have no idea how or why but it no longer works.  Wish I could return it.
